mapper.select: SELECT m.replay_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.synergy_applied_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.replay_id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM m.winner_wizard_id::text) AS winner_wizard_id, m.played_at AS date_add, m.season_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.replay_id = #{rid}

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(BOTH FROM u.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, u.unit_master_id AS unit_master_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u WHERE u.replay_id = #{rid} AND COALESCE(u.is_banned, false) = false ORDER BY wizard_id, unit_master_id
SELECT TRIM(BOTH FROM mp.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, CAST(mp.rating_id AS INTEGER) AS rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.replay_id = #{rid}

SELECT mp.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM mp.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, CAST(mp.rating_id AS INTEGER) AS rating_id FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) ORDER BY mp.replay_id, mp.wizard_id

SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM m.winner_wizard_id::text) AS winner_wizard_id, m.played_at AS date_add, m.season_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) ORDER BY m.replay_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.replay_id AS rid, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.wizard_id::text) AS wizard_id, u.unit_master_id AS unit_master_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u WHERE u.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) AND COALESCE(u.is_banned, false) = false ORDER BY u.replay_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_synergy_combo (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key, combo_size, match_cnt, win_cnt) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.comboKey}, #{r.comboSize}, #{r.matchDelta}, #{r.winDelta})
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key) DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_combo.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_combo.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_synergy_combo ( season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key, combo_size, match_cnt, win_cnt ) SELECT s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.combo_unit_key, MAX(s.combo_size)::smallint AS combo_size, SUM(s.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(s.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.staging_synergy_agg s GROUP BY s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.combo_unit_key ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, combo_unit_key) DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_combo.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_synergy_combo.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_counter_matchup ( season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key, opponent_combo_size, win_cnt, lose_cnt ) VALUES
(#{r.seasonId}, #{r.ratingId}, #{r.subjectUnitId}, #{r.opponentComboKey}, #{r.opponentComboSize}::smallint, #{r.winDelta}::bigint, #{r.loseDelta}::bigint)
ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key) DO UPDATE SET win_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, opponent_combo_size = EXCLUDED.opponent_combo_size

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_counter_matchup ( season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key, opponent_combo_size, win_cnt, lose_cnt ) SELECT s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.subject_unit_id, s.opponent_combo_key, MAX(s.opponent_combo_size)::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(s.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(s.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.staging_matchup_agg s GROUP BY s.season_id, s.rating_id, s.subject_unit_id, s.opponent_combo_key ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, subject_unit_id, opponent_combo_key) DO UPDATE SET win_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_counter_matchup.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, opponent_combo_size = EXCLUDED.opponent_combo_size
mapper.update: UPDATE public.rta_match SET synergy_applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, synergy_apply_result = 'S' WHERE replay_id = #{rid}
UPDATE public.rta_match SET synergy_applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, synergy_apply_result = 'S' WHERE replay_id = ANY(#{rids})
UPDATE public.rta_match SET synergy_applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, synergy_apply_result = 'F' WHERE replay_id = #{rid}
mapper.select: WITH , latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), ranked AS ( SELECT latest.wizard_id, latest.wizard_name, latest.country, latest.channel_uid, latest.score, latest.rating_id, latest.last_match_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latest.score DESC, latest.wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM latest ) SELECT r.rank_position, r.wizard_id, r.wizard_name, r.country, r.channel_uid, r.score, r.rating_id FROM ranked r WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(#{query})) >= 1 AND ( TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(#{query}) OR ( r.wizard_name IS NOT NULL AND POSITION(LOWER(TRIM(#{query})) IN LOWER(r.wizard_name)) > 0 ) ) ORDER BY r.rank_position ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", season_code AS "seasonCode", season_no AS "seasonNo", league_type AS "leagueType", season_name AS "seasonName", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", is_active AS "isActive", sort_order AS "sortOrder", to_char((start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startYmdKst", to_char(((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "lastInclusiveYmdKst", to_char((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endExclusiveYmdKst" FROM rta_season ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC, season_code ASC
SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", season_code AS "seasonCode" FROM rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT season_code FROM rta_season WHERE start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND end_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT season_code FROM rta_season ORDER BY season_no DESC, season_code DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

SELECT rating_id AS "ratingId", grade_name AS "gradeName", grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", tier_key AS "tierKey", min_win_points AS "minWinPoints", rank_rule AS "rankRule", icon_url AS "iconUrl", tier_sort AS "tierSort" FROM public.rta_rating_grade WHERE tier_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tier_sort NULLS LAST, rating_id

WITH sid AS ( SELECT season_id FROM public.rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1 ), mx AS ( SELECT MAX(s.snapshot_at) AS ts FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s WHERE s.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM sid) ) SELECT s.snapshot_at AS "snapshotAt", s.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.tier_key AS "tierKey", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", s.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore" FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.rating_id = s.rating_id CROSS JOIN mx WHERE s.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM sid) AND mx.ts IS NOT NULL AND s.snapshot_at = mx.ts ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, s.rating_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap (snapshot_at, sort_order, anchor_key, tier_key, cutoff_score) WITH , rank_window AS ( SELECT (MAX(r.date_add)::date - INTERVAL '120 days')::date AS min_date FROM rta_match_in_season r ), rta_match_in_window AS ( SELECT r.rid, r.date_add, r.winner_wizard_id, r.battle_type FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN rank_window w ON r.date_add::date >= w.min_date ), anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_window r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 1000 AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3'), ('G2'), ('G1'), ('P3'), ('P2'), ('P1') ) AS tv(tier_key) ) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.tier_key, COALESCE(MIN(b.score_val), 0)::bigint AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN base b ON b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, a.iv, t.tier_key

INSERT INTO public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut (season_id, snapshot_at, rating_id, cutoff_score) SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.season_id, rg.rating_id) s.season_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rg.rating_id, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT)) FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id WHERE m.played_at >= s.start_at AND m.played_at < s.end_at AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) = rg.rating_id AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ), 0)::bigint FROM public.rta_season s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.tier_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.season_id, rg.rating_id
mapper.select: SELECT x.opponent_combo_key AS "opponentComboKey", x.opponent_combo_size AS "opponentComboSize", x.win_cnt AS "winCnt", x.lose_cnt AS "loseCnt", CASE WHEN (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * x.win_cnt::numeric / (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "winRate", ( SELECT string_agg(m.kr_name, ' + ' ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(string_to_array(x.opponent_combo_key, ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS z(id, ord) LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM z.id), '') ) AS "opponentLabel" FROM ( SELECT c.opponent_combo_key, MAX(c.opponent_combo_size)::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(c.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(c.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_counter_matchup c WHERE c.season_id = (SELECT season_id FROM public.rta_season WHERE season_code = #{seasonCode} LIMIT 1) AND c.subject_unit_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY c.opponent_combo_key ) x ORDER BY (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40
